Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a business and occupation tax exemption for charter schools and nonprofit education service providers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing a business and occupation taxexemption for charter schools and nonprofit education serviceproviders; amending RCW 82.04.419 and 82.04.600; adding a new sectionto chapter 82.04 RCW; and repealing RCW 82.04.395.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 82.04.419 and 1983 1st ex.s. c 66 s 3 are each amendedto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) This chapter ((shall)) does not apply to any county, city,town, school district, or fire district activity, regardless of howfinanced, other than a utility or enterprise activity as defined by thestate auditor pursuant to RCW 35.33.111 and 36.40.220 and upon whichthe tax imposed pursuant to this chapter had previously applied.Nothing contained in this section ((shall)) limits the authority of thelegislature to authorize the imposition of such tax prospectively uponsuch activities as the legislature ((shall)) specifically designates. (2) A charter school as defined in RCW 28A.710.010 is exempt fromthe taxes imposed in this chapter to the same extent as a schooldistrict.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter does not apply to amounts received by a nonprofiteducation service provider under a contract with a charter schoolpursuant to RCW 28A.710.030 to the extent such amounts are received foreducational instructional services, or for management and operation ofa charter school.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 82.04.600 and 1979 ex.s. c 266 s 8 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) This chapter does not apply to any county as defined in Title36 RCW, any city or town as defined in Title 35 RCW, any schooldistrict or educational service district as defined in Title 28A RCW,any charter school, or any library or library district as defined inTitle 27 RCW, in respect to materials printed in the county, city,town, school district, educational service district, charter school,library or library district facilities when the materials are usedsolely for county, city, town, school district, educational servicedistrict, charter school, library, or library district purposes. (2) For purposes of this section, "charter school" has the samemeaning as in RCW 28A.710.010 and also includes a nonprofitorganization that has contracted with a charter school as defined inRCW 28A.710.010 to provide educational instructional services, or formanagement and operation of a charter school, pursuant to RCW28A.710.030.
RCW 82.04.395 (ExemptionsCertain materialsprinted in school district and educational service district printingfacilities) and 1979 ex.s. c 196 s 12 are each repealed.
